mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dpm_version (project_id, version_no, version_name, status, planned_start_date, planned_release_date, released_at, description) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{versionNo}, #{versionName}, #{status}, #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedReleaseDate}, #{releasedAt}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_version SET project_id = #{request.projectId}, version_no = #{request.versionNo}, version_name = #{request.versionName}, status = #{request.status}, planned_start_date = #{request.plannedStartDate}, planned_release_date = #{request.plannedReleaseDate}, released_at = #{request.releasedAt}, description = #{request.description} WHERE id = #{id}
